sources.name: BusElche / Avanza official pages for Lines D, F and H
Current Elche D, F and H ordered route-cycle PDFs
Ordered D, F and H stop pages with municipal codes and map coordinates
Accepted Elche A/B/C scenario used for shared StopNode and StopPlace identity reuse

transformations.description: Captures the complete public D, F and H route cycles. Published repeated terminal occurrences are removed where present, and each cycle is represented once with closesLoop=true.
Uses municipal stop code as the stable elche-stop and elche-place suffix. Shared identifiers from the accepted A/B/C package are copied without modification.
Creates one strict parser-compatible physical StopPlace for every new directional StopNode. No proximity-only physical merges are made.
Writes the established scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and registers the scenario.

warnings: Runtime StopNode sourceReferences are empty because the transport-domain field accepts only genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position components; municipal codes and AliBus coordinates remain build provenance.
Eight StopNodes shared with the accepted A/B/C package retain the exact previous StopNode and StopPlace bytes, including their existing coordinates.
New D/F/H StopNodes use coordinates exposed by current stop map links. They should still be reconciled to canonical OpenStreetMap platform and stop_position evidence in the later automated workflow.
D, F and H are represented as explicit circular patterns. The first StopNode is not repeated at the end; closesLoop=true adds the closing edge.
Physical StopPlace creation does not create route edges or infer reverse patterns.
